reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g1_na_q3_4), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The items directly fulfill the competency requirement of subtracting numbers less than 100 without regrouping, covering both 2-digit minus 1-digit numbers (e.g. seed 502: "There are 69 candies. Taking away 7 candies leaves how many candies?") and 2-digit minus 2-digit numbers (e.g. seed 42: "Start at 12. Count back 11. What number do you land on?", seed 44: "There are 90 stars. Taking away 20 stars leaves ___ stars.", seed 45: "There are 66 erasers. Taking away 30 erasers leaves how many erasers?", seed 501: "There are 91 candies. Taking away 71 candies leaves ___ candies.", and seed 604: "Start at 35. Count back 15. What number do you land on?"). Both concrete take-away scenarios and pictorial/number-line counting-back models are actively used.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The sample set comprehensively covers the required cases including 2-digit minus 1-digit subtraction (seed 502), subtracting multiples of 10 (seed 43: "Start at 45. Count back 10. What number do you land on?", seed 44, seed 45, seed 603: "Start at 48. Count back 30. You land on ___"), arbitrary 2-digit subtraction without regrouping (seed 42: 12 - 11, seed 501: 91 - 71, seed 604: 35 - 15), and subtracting equal quantities down to zero (seed 600: "There are 50 erasers. Taking away 50 erasers leaves how many erasers?").

cognitive_capacity.rationale: All items are well suited to Grade 1 Quarter 3 learners. Question stems are succinct and readable (e.g. seed 85: "Start at 20. Count back 10. You land on 10. True or False?", seed 601: "Start at 13. Count back 10. You land on 3. True or False?"). Contexts utilize age-appropriate objects (stars, candies, frogs, drinks, erasers) without excessive reading complexity or multi-step operations.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The generator demonstrates wide variant diversity across formatters, including standard multiple-choice ('mcq' in seeds 42, 43, 45, 46, 502, 600, 602, 604), fill-in-the-blank ('cloze' in seeds 44, 501, 603), error detection (seed 50: "There are 43 candies. Taking away 30 candies leaves ___ candies."), visual/reading comprehension ('read_mcq' in seed 55: "Taking away 10 frogs.", seed 500, and seed 605: "The dot is at 70 and it moves backward 40 numbers. Starting from 70, just count back 40 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?"), and true/false ('true_false' in seeds 85, 601).

competency_alignment.rationale: Every subtraction problem in the packet strictly avoids regrouping (e.g., in seed 502 69 - 7 leaves 2 in the ones place with 9 - 7; in seed 501 91 - 71 leaves 0 in the ones place with 1 - 1; in seed 45 66 - 30 leaves 6 in the ones place with 6 - 0). All numbers used are strictly less than 100, adhering exactly to MATATAG specifications for Grade 1 Quarter 3.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The numerical values span the appropriate range for this competency (< 100), testing two-digit numbers across multiple decades (12, 13, 20, 33, 35, 43, 45, 48, 50, 63, 66, 69, 70, 81, 90, 91) and subtrahends varying from single digits (7) to tens (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80) and two-digit numbers (11, 15, 71).
